personality_one_liner: An ultra-premium, cinematic booking experience with deep black backgrounds, delicate gold accents, and frosted glass overlays.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the black backgrounds to breathe. Do not crowd elements.

do's: Floating Action Buttons (like the WhatsApp button)

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase the salon's brand, slogan, info, and a luxurious list of 14 services.

states.loading: Centered gold spinner over black background.
states.error: Error message with a retry button in gold.

screens.layout: Cinematic hero section with the salon logo (using local asset if provided, otherwise styled text) and slogan. Blurred background photo with gradient scrim. Below, address and hours. A list of 14 services with price and duration (single column, luxurious padding). A floating glass FAB for WhatsApp pinned at the bottom right. Sticky 'Book Now' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: A seamless step-by-step appointment booking experience.

states.empty: No slots available message with 'Pick another date'.
states.error: Failed to load slots, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Step 1: Select Service. Step 2: Date Picker (horizontal elegant scroll). Step 3: Time Slot Grid (glass pills). Step 4: Client Info Form (Name, Phone). Bottom-anchored sticky 'Confirm' CTA.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Secure hub for the 2 admins to manage bookings, clients, and settings.
screens.layout: Login screen with password input. Dashboard showing today's agenda (Day view). Navigation links to 'Clients', 'History', and 'Settings' (to block days/holidays).

screens.name: Admin Clients & History
screens.purpose: Manage the client base, import from .vcf, and view visit history.

states.empty: No clients found. Import or add manually.

screens.layout: Search bar at top. List of clients. Top action to 'Import .vcf / Phone Contacts'. Tapping a client opens a detail sheet with their visit history.

hero_background.alt: Luxury barbershop dark interior with black and silver chair

empty_state_tools.alt: Close view of gold barber tools on a dark countertop

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality. The app should feel highly premium, cinematic, and expensive.
Use deep black (#050404) for the main surface. DO NOT use grey as the main background.
Gold (#C5A059) is the only accent color. Do not introduce blues, purples, or other colors.
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is used for headings and large display texts to establish the luxury feel. Use 'Satoshi' for body text and UI labels.

The user mentioned an 'attached logo'—since we don't have file access, provide an implementation that can easily swap in a local asset (e.g., require('./assets/logo.png')). Make sure it sits prominently at the top over the dark hero background.
For any text overlaying the hero background or images, ALWAYS apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0: image, Layer 1: linear gradient to #050404, Layer 2: text) to guarantee readability.
The floating WhatsApp button MUST be implemented natively using safe areas and bottom spacing, ideally wrapped in a glass container.
The booking flow requires a sticky 'Confirm' CTA anchored at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.
Ensure the Admin agenda accurately maps time slots and blocks exactly the duration of the selected service.
